environment.source_policy: Kernel source and headers are unmodified; the compilation database contains the exact commands from an out-of-tree arm64 Kbuild.

measurements.name: initial-generated-machdep
measurements.first_blocker: The generated file stored aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc as the semantic compiler family, disabling GCC parsing and censoring __SIZEOF_INT128__.

measurements.name: after-compiler-family-correction
measurements.first_blocker: AArch64 headers use GCC's predefined __uint128_t alias without including a userspace header.

measurements.name: after-kernel-int128-aliases
measurements.first_blocker: A constant ternary passed to __builtin_constant_p was lowered through a temporary, selecting a non-constant ilog2 fallback in NR_KERNFS_LOCKS.

compatibility_changes: Detect and store the compiler semantic family separately from the cross-compiler executable.
Preserve the executable so generated cross machdeps regenerate byte-for-byte with --from-file.
Add the generated GCC AArch64 LP64 machdep and focused ABI/macro regression.
Model GCC's predefined signed and unsigned 128-bit aliases in the kernel-safe compiler header.
Preserve constant conditional operands for foldable GCC builtins.
Constant-fold nonzero __builtin_clz, __builtin_clzl, __builtin_clzll, __builtin_ctz, __builtin_ctzl, and __builtin_ctzll calls using the selected machdep widths.
interpretation: Typed means preprocessing, parsing, type-checking, normalization, and Metrics completed for this pinned corpus. It is not a proof of functional correctness, an ARM weak-memory model, or precise semantics for AArch64 inline assembly.
